description: This file defines an interface for a composition buffer (`ICompositionBuffer`) within the WPEFramework’s Exchange namespace. It provides virtual methods for managing buffer planes, reference counting, buffer properties, and rendering. The interface appears to be intended for hardware-optimized frame buffer handling, supporting different data types and pixel formats.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: An interface for a hardware-optimized frame buffer with methods for access, referencing, and rendering.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IPlane
classes.description: Represents a single plane within the buffer, providing access to buffer data, stride, and offset.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IIterator
classes.description: An iterator for traversing the planes of the buffer, with methods to validate, reset, and move to the next plane.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increases the reference count of the buffer object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count, possibly deleting the object when count reaches zero.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the buffer's planes with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Notifies that the buffer is done being used, possibly marking it as dirty.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for display scanout.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns a modifier for the pixel arrangement, used for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer (invalid, DMA, raw).
